bounds: One environment, one complete four-client source snapshot, empty or committed database, staged rows, and atomic receipt. Release admission has absent, unbound, bound, or invalid markers; boolean schema, identity, source availability and retained-row state. Retry and rollback preserve committed state; a bound marker permits later reviewed row deletion without source reads.
limitations: Abstracts SQL row contents and provider/identity authenticity as validated input; actual parser, alias and database checks are covered by the linked PGlite importer test.
Atomic safety is modeled. Completion requires a valid stable source and a scheduled commit after stage; no liveness under provider failure is claimed.

Release admission assumes preceding canonical source and production certification succeeded. The separate staging-release-certification test checks actual workflow dependency ordering before Worker and Pages activation.
